test_title: PYST 05: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The head coach declared that the player **__who will score the most points__** in the game will clinch the trophy this year

options.text: who were score the maximum points
who have score the maximum points

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is based on the **first conditional** structure, which is used to talk about real and possible situations in the future.
 
• The rule for the first conditional is: **If + present simple, will + base verb**.
 
• In this context, the clause "**who scores the maximum points**" correctly uses the **present simple** tense, aligning with the future result "**will clinch the trophy**."

 

**Correct Sentence:** *The head coach declared that the player who **scores the maximum points** in the game will clinch the trophy this year.*
